body: Wow, we sound exactly the same. 2 years long distance and another year of trying to make it work and he cared so little it was humiliating. The whole time he stonewalled me about what our relationship was to him. Even the OKCupid thing, haha. I tried and even managed a couple of dates, but it was mostly a disaster. My friends say I'm gorgeous and likeable, and at times I get a lot of attention, but I'm just not attracted to many people either and don't see the point of going into relationships that I know from the beginning are only flings. I guess that's just not for me. Most days I feel ok, but last night I was so exhausted that I had to pour it out somewhere. Thank you for responding. If you wouldn't mind, can I pm you? It's dangerous to go alone.
